skills.skill: Add and subtract fractions with like denominators

misconceptions.pattern: Adds (or subtracts) the denominators as well as the numerators (e.g. 1/5 + 2/5 answered 3/10 instead of 3/5), instead of keeping the shared denominator.

strategies.intent: The pieces are the same size (same denominator), so just count how many you have after joining or taking away — the denominator does not change.
